transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling really down and depressed lately, and it's been going on for about seven months now. I just feel this constant, heavy sadness that I can't seem to shake.
Have you had any periods during the past seven months when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood been present nearly every day the whole time?
No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. This heavy, gloomy feeling has been there nearly every single day for the entire seven months. I really haven't felt like my usual self even for a day.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder], but based on this conversation, the mood has been present nearly every day for seven months with no symptom-free periods. That chronic, continuous course is more consistent with Persistent Depressive Disorder, while Major Depressive Disorder is less likely because the duration and pattern suggest a longer-standing depressive condition rather than a discrete episode.
